text_block_list.text:
You're so cool, Trainer! You handled
those
controls like a pro!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Did you train somewhere? What school
did you
go to? What's your rank?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I can't wait until the day your skills and
spirit pass
on to me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'll follow you forever, so please take me
under
your wing! That's a super promise,
okay?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
